text.text: Released in 2002, Sega Chihiro was an arcade platform based on Microsoft's original Xbox hardware. Designed for high-performance 3D arcade games, it combined Xbox technology with Sega's arcade architecture and expanded memory. Chihiro powered titles including OutRun 2, OutRun 2 SP, Ghost Squad, Ollie King, Crazy Taxi High Roller, Virtua Cop 3, and The House of the Dead III. Its PC-inspired design made it one of Sega's most capable arcade systems before the transition to the Lindbergh platform.
